description: Enrich a single company by domain, website, or LinkedIn URL: industry, headcount, revenue, funding history, technologies in use, and more. BYOK: pass your own Apollo _apiKey. Apollo cost: 1 Apollo credit per organization enriched. Example: apollo_enrich_organization({ domain: "apollo.io", _apiKey: "your-apollo-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Apollo API key. Get one at https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key.

name.description: Company name, to improve match accuracy. Cannot be used alone — pair with domain/website/linkedin_url.

website.description: Full website URL, e.g. "http://www.apollo.io". Alternative to `domain`.
